errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по часовниковата стрелка, започвайки от най-големия в дясната част на диаграмата.
errors.evidence: The description claims that going clockwise starts with the largest sector (24.67%). This is incorrect. Starting from the top, the first sector is 23.61%, followed by the largest one (24.67%).
The description incorrectly maps the category 'Единични продукти' (Single products) to the value 8.75%. According to the legend, 8.75% corresponds to the category 'Други палети' (Other pallets).

errors.text_span: „Продукти без опаковка“ с 6.63% и с черно-бяло шахматно покритие
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns a 'black-and-white checkerboard pattern' to the 6.63% sector. In the chart, the 6.63% sector ('Единични продукти без опаковка') has a vertical line pattern. The checkerboard pattern belongs to the 6.37% sector.

errors.text_span: „Насипи продукти“ с 6.37% и с черно-бяло кръстосано покритие
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns a 'black-and-white crossed pattern' (crosshatch) to the 6.37% sector. In the chart, the 6.37% sector ('Насипи продукти') has a checkerboard pattern. The crosshatch pattern belongs to the 17.51% sector.

errors.text_span: Няма визуално подчертаване на някой от секторите чрез изместване или удебеляване.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there is no visual emphasis by shifting sectors. The figure is an exploded pie chart, where all sectors are visually separated (shifted) from the center, which is a form of visual emphasis.
